name: Buggy Dune Bashing Tour
summary: Looking for a desert dune buggy Dubai experience? self-drive buggy tours across the iconic red dunes near Al Badayer, on the Sharjah border. Drive your own 195hp Polaris RZR or Can-Am X3 Maverick with an expert guide leading the convoy across dunes, gravel tracks and salt flats. Choose from morning, afternoon or night departures. All gear, GoPro photos and pickup from Dubai are included. we bring exciting desert tours to everyone.

children.note: Children below 16 years are not permitted to drive the buggy and may join only as passengers
